scope: Read-only current source audit; no Git, native engine, compiler, receiver, database, secret or network execution; no new qualification. No tests executed.
disposition: Existing primitives support exact retained-operation reconciliation; new fresh/resume composition needs explicit retained-state and authority admission. Historical eight-publication proof does not itself establish process-level resume.

checks.finding: The injected native loss occurs after actual collect. Ordinal 1 manifest and ordinal 3 native-response recovery reopen the original journal with fresh driver/context, but retain Spark and copy the current in-memory active plan. This is not independent process restart or arbitrary uncertain-operation recovery.

Historical run permits exclusively fresh output. Existing transport distinguishes initialize from reopen; original registry includes installation, exact table/path/UUID and optional capacity, with original journal path bound into reservation and native properties. Reopen requires the same existing non-symlink journal and exact stored registry/schema. Missing journal must not select initialization or a replacement journal.

Direct recover refuses a missing operation. Retained prepared operations may submit after exact predecessor check; submitted operations are not resubmitted. Exactly one original commit metadata match at before_version+1 and matching snapshot/receipt is required. Zero or multiple matches remain uncertain and cannot authorize replacement mutation or ACK.

Whole-effect recovery first requires exact retained ordered local_plan and source_plan. It intentionally calls mutation for each deterministic plan ordinal, allowing original not-yet-submitted ordinals to proceed; the per-operation custody still prevents replaying submitted ordinals. Do not describe recovery as forbidding every missing per-operation row or allowing arbitrary missing plans.

New resume must independently re-establish exact request, generated/selected ordered steps, zero-match elisions, complete prior oracle, native-prior UUID/version/snapshot anchors, source-qualified prefix/checkpoints, publication identity/progress and retained manifest/artifact as appropriate to original attempt phase. Current host driver compares these against original journal and native source, but receives active policy state from its caller. Pure whole-entity state recovery only reconstructs an admitted contiguous retained source interval; it grants no source/ACK/native-effect authority.

ACK requires original retained request/artifact, native registered scope/source signature, authoritative resolved whole manifest and held pin vector with opening/closing admission. Injected PostgreSQL loss follows actual commit and is reconciled on a fresh ordinary-role connection by exact request/manifest/receipt bytes. Reconcile is read-only observation: exact predecessor with all receipt fields absent yields None; partial/conflicting/missing/ambiguous observations refuse. The driver does not silently issue a replacement ACK when reconcile returns None.

Historical admission requires fresh public UMF dataset/source-preservation verification plus exact prepared changes and independently derived prior/entity transition pairs. It expressly does not establish producer/source installation authority, migration durability or ACK truth. Portable preparation/oracle and injected admission must preserve this separation; ordinary source connection and registered ACK scope authority belong to the host composition.

Historical runner attempts transport and Spark close before report, but finally cleanup can replace an in-flight primary exception. ACK intentionally classifies write/commit uncertainty with original custody; new outer resume/report handling must preserve cancellation identity separately from any retained uncertainty evidence. No all-cancellation-preserved claim follows from this historical tool.
